ontology.name: generic-knowledge-graph
ontology.description: Generic ontology for document-derived knowledge graphs. Covers common entity types and relation types across domains including research, business, news, legal, and general knowledge extraction.

properties.name: onto:Person
properties.description: An individual human being — named or referenced by role.
properties.examples: Alice, Dr. Smith, the CEO, Hailey Johnson

properties.name: onto:Organization
properties.description: A structured group — company, government body, NGO, team, institution.
properties.examples: OpenSearch Project, United Nations, Fresh Bread Inc.

properties.name: onto:Location
properties.description: A geographic or virtual place — city, country, address, region, facility, URL.
properties.examples: San Francisco, Building 44, us-west-2, the conference room

properties.name: onto:Event
properties.description: A happening with temporal extent — meeting, incident, release, election, delivery.
properties.examples: Q1 board meeting, product launch, bread delivery, Thanksgiving

properties.name: onto:Concept
properties.description: An abstract idea, theory, methodology, field of study, or domain term.
properties.examples: sustainability, machine learning, rational grazing, GraphRAG

properties.name: onto:Artifact
properties.description: A human-made object or digital creation — document, product, tool, software, dataset.
properties.examples: quarterly report, OpenSearch plugin, Toyota Camry, LDBC dataset

properties.name: onto:Method
properties.description: A technique, process, algorithm, or procedure.
properties.examples: BFS traversal, entity extraction pipeline, crop rotation, HNSW indexing

properties.name: onto:NaturalObject
properties.description: A naturally occurring entity — species, mineral, body of water, celestial object.
properties.examples: varroa mite, Colorado River, oak tree, nitrogen

properties.name: onto:Creature
properties.description: A living organism — animal, plant, microorganism (when the biological identity is salient).

properties.name: onto:Content
properties.description: An information artifact — publication, book, article, podcast, video, dataset.
properties.examples: research paper, Lenny's Podcast episode, Wikipedia article, annual report

properties.name: onto:Data
properties.description: A quantitative or structured datum — metric, measurement, statistic, identifier.

properties.name: onto:RELATED_TO
properties.description: Generic association when no more specific relation applies.

properties.name: onto:WORKS_AT
properties.description: Person is employed by or affiliated with an organization.

properties.name: onto:LOCATED_IN
properties.description: Entity is geographically or logically situated within a location.

properties.name: onto:PART_OF
properties.description: Entity is a component, member, or subdivision of another entity.

properties.name: onto:CREATED_BY
properties.description: Artifact, content, or method was authored or produced by a person or organization.

properties.name: onto:USES
properties.description: Entity employs, applies, or depends on another entity.

properties.name: onto:KNOWS
properties.description: Person knows or has a social connection with another person.

properties.name: onto:PARTICIPATED_IN
properties.description: Person or organization took part in an event.

properties.name: onto:OCCURRED_AT
properties.description: Event took place at a location.

properties.name: onto:STUDIES
properties.description: Person or organization researches or investigates a concept, method, or natural object.

properties.name: onto:PRODUCES
properties.description: Organization or person manufactures, publishes, or generates an artifact or content.

properties.name: onto:MEASURES
properties.description: Data quantifies or describes an attribute of another entity.

properties.name: onto:DERIVED_FROM
properties.description: Entity is derived, adapted, or evolved from another entity.

properties.name: onto:IMPACTS
properties.description: Entity affects, influences, or has consequences for another entity.

properties.name: onto:SUPERSEDES
properties.description: Entity replaces or is a newer version of another entity.

_comment: To load this ontology into a docgraph database, iterate over concepts and relations and POST each to _upsert_ontology. Example: curl -X POST '.../_plugins/_graph/docgraph/{db}/_upsert_ontology' -d '{"ontology_id": "onto:Person", "ontology_kind": "ontology_concept", "labels": ["OntologyConcept"], "properties": {"name": "onto:Person", "description": "..."}}'
loader_script: for item in ontology.concepts: POST _upsert_ontology(ontology_id=item.ontology_id, ontology_kind='ontology_concept', labels=item.labels, properties=item.properties); for item in ontology.relations: POST _upsert_ontology(ontology_id=item.ontology_id, ontology_kind='ontology_relation', labels=item.labels, properties=item.properties)
